map.按车辆价格、使用性质、险种组合与 NCD 系数粗估年度保费，辅助投保方案比价与预: Rough-estimates the annual premium from vehicle price, usage category, cover combination and the NCD factor, for comparing policies and budgeting.
map.6 座以下家用基准 950 元: Baseline 950 yuan for private use up to 6 seats
map.200 万起，一线建议 300 万+: From 2 million; 3 million+ in top-tier cities
map.已并入盗抢、玻璃、涉水等责任: Now bundles theft, glass and water damage
map.保额低、边际成本低: Low cover at low marginal cost
map.连续未出险年数越长，商业险折扣越大，最高可达基准的 6 折。出险一次即回退甚至上: The longer you go claim-free the bigger the commercial discount, down to 60% of the base rate. A single claim resets it or even adds a loading, so paying for small scratches yourself is often cheaper than claiming.
map.一线城市赔付标准高、费率上浮；车型风险等级（零整比、被盗率）也影响车损险费率，豪: Top-tier cities face higher payouts and rate loadings; model risk class (parts ratio, theft rate) also moves own-damage rates, and luxury cars with high parts ratios cost noticeably more to insure.
map.⚠️ 本工具为粗估口径（基准费率 + NCD + 地区系数），实际保费以保险公司: ⚠️ This tool gives a rough estimate (base rate + NCD + regional factor); the actual premium follows the insurer's underwriting quote and quotes differ by more than 20% between companies.
map.投保前输入车型、车价、地区与所选险种，快速预估年度保费，比价不同方案。: Before buying cover, enter model, vehicle price, region and chosen cover to estimate the annual premium and compare plans.
map.续保时对比去年与今年报价差异，判断是否换公司或调整险种。: At renewal, compare this year's quote with last year's to decide whether to switch insurer or adjust cover.
map.新车落地核算时，把保险纳入总持有成本一并预算。: When costing a new car, fold insurance into total ownership cost for budgeting.
map.交强险+商业险粗估: Rough estimate: compulsory plus commercial cover
map.家用 6 座以下新车交强险固定 950 元；商业险中车损险≈车价×1.2% 左右: Compulsory traffic insurance for a private car up to 6 seats is fixed at 950 yuan; commercial cover puts own damage at about 1.2% of vehicle price and third-party 2 million at roughly 1000–1500 yuan, plus the deductible waiver and similar items, totaling several thousand yuan. Actual rates vary with model risk class, claim history and regional factors; the insurer's quote governs.
map.三者险买多少合适？: How much third-party cover should I buy?
map.建议至少 200 万，一线城市或豪车密集区可 300 万以上；人伤与物损赔偿标准: Buy at least 2 million, and 3 million or more in top-tier cities or districts dense with luxury cars; injury and property awards climb every year, so a low limit saves little but risks much. Premium rises with the limit while marginal cost falls, making higher limits good value.
map.出险次数怎么影响保费？: How do claims affect the premium?
map.无赔款优待（NCD）随连续未出险年数折扣递增，出险一次次年折扣回退甚至上浮。小刮: The no-claim discount grows with each consecutive claim-free year; one claim resets the discount next year or even triggers a loading. Paying out of pocket for small scratches may beat claiming, so weigh this year's and next year's premiums together.
map.本工具为粗估口径，实际保费以保险公司核保报价为准，不同公司差异可达 20% 以上: This tool gives a rough estimate; actual premium follows the insurer's underwriting quote and quotes differ by more than 20% between companies
